svg.title: Test a change on a few projects first
svg.desc: A team can run several coding sessions across different projects. A small trial limits how many projects a mistake can affect. Pick a pilot. Choose a small set of projects that will show whether the change works. Run the checks. Save a separate result for each project. Use the same checks as you add more projects. Decide. Continue only after the trial passes the agreed checks. Stop if a required test fails.
